# @ethan/designbook

> Design Book — a themeable Svelte 5 UI framework and component library.

Svelte 5 component library with three themes (slate, folio, terminal), light/dark schemes and two densities, all driven by CSS custom properties. Components reference semantic tokens only.

## Start here

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): conventions, token rules, definition of done
- [PLAN.md](PLAN.md): architecture and roadmap
- [Tokens](src/lib/tokens/semantic.css): every semantic token a component may use
- [Theme controller](src/lib/theme/theme.svelte.ts): theme / scheme / density API
- [Registry](registry.json): machine-readable component manifest

## Components

- [Alert](src/lib/components/alert/README.md): An inline message that stays in the page: status, warnings, errors, or context the user should read before acting. For transient feedback use Toast instead.
- [Avatar](src/lib/components/avatar/README.md): Image or initials for a person or entity. Falls back to initials automatically when there is no image or it fails to load, with a stable per-name background hue.
- [Badge](src/lib/components/badge/README.md): Small status label. Three variants and six tones cover statuses, counts and categories; a `dot` adds a status indicator.
- [Button](src/lib/components/button/README.md): The primary action control. Renders a `<button>` by default, or an `<a>` when `href` is given, with identical styling in both cases. Five visual variants × three tones × three sizes cover every button in a typical app without custom CSS.
- [Card](src/lib/components/card/README.md): A surface that groups related content. Three variants (outlined, elevated, filled), optional header and footer rows, and an interactive mode for clickable cards.
- [Checkbox](src/lib/components/checkbox/README.md): A native checkbox with a custom box. Supports an indeterminate state for "select all" and an optional description line.
- [Container](src/lib/components/container/README.md): Centres content with a max width from the `--container-*` scale and page-level horizontal padding.
- [Dialog](src/lib/components/dialog/README.md): A modal window built on Bits UI's Dialog: focus is trapped, the page behind is inert and scroll-locked, Escape and overlay clicks close it (unless `dismissible={false}`), and focus returns to the trigger on close.
- [Divider](src/lib/components/divider/README.md): A hairline separator, horizontal or vertical, with an optional centred label.
- [Field](src/lib/components/field/README.md): Wraps a form control with a label, optional hint and error message, and wires the accessibility attributes for you: the label's `for`, the control's `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `required` and `disabled` all flow through context.
- [Grid](src/lib/components/grid/README.md): CSS grid with two modes: a fixed column count, or responsive auto-fit columns with a minimum width. Both keep a token-driven gap.
- [Heading](src/lib/components/heading/README.md): Semantic heading (h1–h6) in the theme's display face. Visual size is decoupled from the level so document outlines stay correct while the design does what it needs.
- [Inline](src/lib/components/inline/README.md): Horizontal flex layout that wraps by default. Use for button rows, tag clouds, toolbars and metadata lines.
- [Input](src/lib/components/input/README.md): Single-line text input with optional leading/trailing adornments. Reads label, hint, error, required and disabled from a surrounding Field.
- [Menu](src/lib/components/menu/README.md): A dropdown menu of actions, built on Bits UI's DropdownMenu: arrow-key navigation, typeahead, focus return and dismissal are handled for you. Compose it from `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuCheckboxItem`, `MenuGroup` and `MenuSeparator`.
- [Popover](src/lib/components/popover/README.md): A floating panel anchored to its trigger, for filters, pickers, small forms and previews. Positioning, collision avoidance, focus management and dismissal come from Bits UI.
- [Radio & RadioGroup](src/lib/components/radio/README.md): Single choice from a small set. `RadioGroup` owns the value, name, label, hint and error; `Radio` renders one option and reads the group through context.
- [Select](src/lib/components/select/README.md): A single-choice dropdown built on Bits UI's Select, styled to match Input. Takes a flat `items` array (optionally grouped), works inside Field, and submits through a hidden input when given a `name`.
- [Skeleton](src/lib/components/skeleton/README.md): Loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of the content it stands in for. Hidden from assistive technology; announce loading with `aria-busy` on the region instead.
- [Spinner](src/lib/components/spinner/README.md): Indeterminate loading indicator. Inherits `currentColor` and scales with font size, so it drops into buttons, inputs and text without configuration.
- [Stack](src/lib/components/stack/README.md): Vertical flex layout with a token-driven gap. The default way to space things top-to-bottom; reach for it before writing `margin`.
- [Switch](src/lib/components/switch/README.md): An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately. Use a Checkbox instead when the choice is submitted with a form.
- [Tabs](src/lib/components/tabs/README.md): Switch between sections of related content. Built on Bits UI's Tabs for roving focus and ARIA wiring; compose it from `Tabs`, `TabList`, `Tab` and `TabPanel`.
- [Text](src/lib/components/text/README.md): Body text with size, weight and tone from tokens. Also handles the recurring needs of application text: tabular numerals, truncation and line clamping.
- [Textarea](src/lib/components/textarea/README.md): Multi-line text input. Optional auto-resize grows with content instead of scrolling.
- [Toast](src/lib/components/toast/README.md): Transient notifications. Call `toast()` from anywhere (components, load functions, stores) and render one `<Toaster />` near the root of the app. Toasts auto-dismiss, pause while hovered or focused, and are announced through a polite live region.
- [Tooltip](src/lib/components/tooltip/README.md): A short label shown on hover or keyboard focus. For icon-only buttons and truncated text — never for content the user needs to act on.

## Usage

```svelte
import '@ethan/designbook/styles';
import { Button, theme } from '@ethan/designbook';
```
